title: About page
summary: About the atelier at /about. Enable equals the menu entry. Copy is kernel i18n (about, atelier, values).

blocks.title: Page plugin
blocks.text: plugin.json kind page, route /about. While enabled, the kernel puts the route on the shop menu (nav.key / order). Disable and the URL and menu entry go away. React for home, about, legal, and sizes lives in the kernel; this package is the enablement and SEO listing.

items.description: While Sitemap pages is on, the kernel lists this route on seo.sitemap.entries. Extra paths that are not this route must register the filter yourself (Guides does /pose and /capsules).
